app_summary: A social network with unidirectional follow relationships, implemented with loosely-coupled microservices, communicating with each other via Thrift RPCs. Supported Operations: Create text post (optional media: image, video, shortened URL, user tag), Read post, Read entire user timeline, Receive recommendations on which users to follow, Search database for user or post, Register/Login using user credentials, Follow/Unfollow user

rca_analyses_list.diagnosis: Kubernetes Service "post-storage-service" is misconfigured: the Service exposes port 9090 but its spec.targetPort is set to 9999, so Endpoints point to port 9999 on the pod. The post-storage-service pod listens on container port 9090, so traffic forwarded to port 9999 is refused. Evidence: client logs show connection refused to post-storage-service:9090; post-storage-service Pod describes container port 9090; Service manifest shows targetPort: 9999; Endpoints list contains port 9999 pointing to the pod IP.

args.root_cause: Kubernetes Service "post-storage-service" is misconfigured: the Service exposes port 9090 but its spec.targetPort is set to 9999, so Endpoints point to port 9999 on the pod. The post-storage-service pod listens on container port 9090, so traffic forwarded to port 9999 is refused. Evidence: client logs show connection refused to post-storage-service:9090; post-storage-service Pod describes container port 9090; Service manifest shows targetPort: 9999; Endpoints list contains port 9999 pointing to the pod IP.
args.evidence_summary:
1) Traces for nginx-thrift showed an error trace passing through compose-post-service -> ... -> post-storage-service. (get_traces)
2) compose-post-service logs: repeated Thrift connection refused to Host: post-storage-service Port: 9090 and client pool failures. (get_logs for service compose-post-service)
3) post-storage-service pod logs: service started but earlier MongoDB connection retries; final line shows server starting. (get_logs for pod post-storage-service-9bd8bd979-z248d)
4) post-storage-service Service manifest: port 9090 mapped to targetPort 9999. (kubectl_get service)
5) post-storage-service Endpoints: endpoints subset lists the pod IP with port 9999. (kubectl_get endpoints)
6) pod describe for post-storage-service-9bd8bd979-z248d: container declares Port 9090/TCP and is Ready. (kubectl_describe pod)
These together show Service targetPort != container port, causing kube-proxy to forward to an unused port and produce connection refused errors.
args.investigation_summary: I inspected pods in the test-social-network namespace and error traces rooted at nginx-thrift. compose-post-service logs showed connection refused to post-storage-service:9090. I then examined the post-storage-service pod logs and description to confirm the container listens on 9090. Finally I checked the Service and Endpoints for post-storage-service and found targetPort set to 9999, and endpoints pointing to port 9999 on the pod. The mismatch between Service targetPort (9999) and container port (9090) causes the connection refusals and the observed failures.
